tasks.title: Remove committed contacts and phone numbers
tasks.summary: Move contact data to ignored local configuration, publish sanitized examples, and purge exposed values from Git history before changing repository visibility.

tasks.title: Separate the public kit from private memory and work configuration
tasks.summary: Keep personal routines, employer details, private project knowledge, local endpoints, and user-specific instructions outside the public package.

tasks.title: Choose a root license and finish the provenance audit
tasks.summary: Add a repository-wide open-source license and verify that every vendored or adapted skill carries compatible attribution and licensing.

tasks.title: Pass tracked-content and full-history safety scans
tasks.summary: Scan the current tree and complete Git history for secrets, PII, internal URLs, work email addresses, and proprietary material.

tasks.title: Write the public project and contributor documentation
tasks.summary: Add a root README, installation path, support matrix, configuration guide, security policy, contribution guide, and an explicit code-of-conduct decision.

tasks.title: Make bootstrap fork-neutral
tasks.summary: Replace personal GitHub accounts, SSH aliases, names, and companion-repository assumptions with parameters and opt-in workstation configuration.

tasks.title: Define and enforce the portability boundary
tasks.summary: Remove machine-specific paths and service assumptions from defaults, then document whether the supported baseline is macOS/Homebrew or broader.

tasks.title: Create one reproducible verification command and CI gate
tasks.summary: Run shell checks, extension and Appcraft tests, Python tool-server tests, lockfile checks, provenance checks, and secret scanning from a fresh clone.

tasks.title: Complete package and release metadata
tasks.summary: Add version, description, repository, homepage, issue tracker, license, engines, scripts, and a deliberate distribution policy.

tasks.title: Harden the public tool-server boundary
tasks.summary: Add authentication and capability scopes, separate read-only from side-effecting tools, restrict filesystem and command roots, keep enforced loopback binding, and default SQL redaction to a safe mode.

tasks.title: Define the public skill and extension contract
tasks.summary: Validate metadata, dependencies, supported platforms, provenance, tests, and sanitized examples for every distributed capability.

tasks.title: Exclude generated artifacts and define release contents
tasks.summary: Keep screenshots, browser state, temporary output, runtime data, and generated review material out of public releases.

tasks.title: Pin runtime dependencies and publish an update policy
tasks.summary: Make Python and bootstrap installs reproducible and state supported Node, Python, Pi, and operating-system versions.

tasks.title: Exclude common local secret files
tasks.summary: Environment files, private keys, virtual environments, runtime data, and common build artifacts are ignored.

tasks.title: Test workstation setup and repair paths
tasks.summary: Bootstrap verification covers profile setup, idempotency, links, and strict failure behavior.

tasks.title: Maintain component-level test suites
tasks.summary: Extensions, Appcraft, the tool server, and Personal Build Hub already have focused test coverage.

tasks.title: Bind the local tool server to loopback
tasks.summary: The current runner binds to 127.0.0.1 and documents that the unauthenticated v0 server must not be exposed to a network.
